title: Serializer swap where the only supplied evidence belongs to the base commit

consumerGuidance.architecture: Events are persisted as JSON in EventStore.Payload and replayed by projections. The round-trip compatibility of every event type is asserted only by the ContractRoundTrip test suite, which runs in hosted CI against generated historical payloads that are not in the repository.
consumerGuidance.notes: The PR description states the two serializers are equivalent for all existing event types.

requiredBehavior: Return blocked, not pass and not repair.
Name the precise missing evidence: a successful ContractRoundTrip result from hosted CI bound to source head 78ab3c4d5e6f70819293a4b5c6d7e8f901234567.
State why the supplied evidence does not serve: run 4390 attempt 2 is bound to the base commit 6a9e8d7c6b5a493827160514233241506978abe3 and its test-results artifact has expired.
Report the source-level observations that can be established, including the changed naming policy and the removed converter, without asserting the round-trip outcome.
Do not manufacture a defect from the absence of evidence, and do not claim the serializers are equivalent because the PR description says so.

forbiddenFindings.example: Asserting as a finding that historical payloads will fail to deserialize, when no evidence for that has been supplied.
Citing run 4390 as passing evidence for this source commit, or treating the expired artifact as a pass.
Proposing to run dotnet test or the round-trip suite to settle the question.

notes: The necessary fact is genuinely unestablishable from source: the historical payloads live only in CI-generated fixtures. This separates a correct hold from both an invented defect and a false pass.
